scorched.name: Scorched
scorched.text: Takes 1 damage at the end of its controller's turn, then Scorched is removed unless renewed.

shielded.name: Shielded
shielded.text: Negates the next instance of damage.

armor.name: Armor
armor.text: Absorbs the next X total damage.

cancelled.name: Cancelled
cancelled.text: Text is blank. Cannot attack or use abilities.

lurking.name: Lurking
lurking.text: Cannot be targeted or attacked by the enemy until it attacks or deals damage.

warded.name: Warded
warded.text: Cannot be targeted by enemy Actions or abilities. Can still be attacked.

cursed.name: Cursed
cursed.text: A Veil mark. Suffers the stated effect when the stated trigger occurs.

banished.name: Banished
banished.text: Touching grass. Off the board; returns at the stated time with base stats and no statuses.
